svg.title: Featured project: Atelier Nucléaire, a crafting demo built on industrial process chains. Unity 6.3 LTS, 4 interacting rules, 3 objectives, 106 EditMode tests.

g.text: A crafting demo built on industrial process
No one-click crafting: grind, smelt, run electrolysis,
enrich uranium and drive a fission reactor. Every
item asks which machines to build, how to connect
them and how fast to run them.
